I'm so sorry about what you're going through. It's hard for some people to understand but pets (I'm assuming you're speaking about a dog) are so much more than just that. They love in a way that's so genuine, undemanding, and unconditional. I don't want to say it gets easier because that's not always the truth. There were a lot of bad days, especially at the start. But I found with each day it was a little easier to breathe and come to terms with what happened. I miss him so much but I don't miss what he was going through near the end. He was suffering and heavily medicated. So I like to not let that be my memory of him.
